verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GitLab consolidates security scanning (SAST/SCA/Secret Detection/DAST) into MR workflows and can 'collect audit-ready evidence automatically in every pipeline,' plus agent guardrails/rules set by teams, which supports policy enforcement at a high level. However, there is no direct documentation of compliance frameworks, merge-request approval rules, push rules, or CI/CD template enforcement across teams/repos in this pack. Missing for 10: explicit compliance framework/policy management docs, approval-rule enforcement across projects, independent corroboration of governance features working at scale.
